name: Agent Evidence Verifier
description: Checks evidence a party hands you about an AI agent: that an artifact has the digest its document names, that a bill of materials accounts for the classes you require, and that a conformance result record verifies under a key you pin. It reads public bytes only and keeps nothing.

skills.name: Artifact digest check
skills.description: Given a TEA, CycloneDX or in-toto document and the bytes of an artifact, reports whether the artifact has a digest the document names.
examples: Does log4j-core-2.26.1.jar match the digest in bom.json?

skills.name: Bill of materials coverage check
skills.description: Given a CycloneDX or SPDX 3 document and a list of required component classes, reports which classes are assessed, withheld, covered elsewhere or missing.
examples: Does this BOM account for library, service and machine-learning-model?

skills.name: Conformance result record check
skills.description: Given a signed conformance result record and a pinned Ed25519 public key, reports whether the signature, the statement and the score fields verify.
examples: Does this conformance record verify under the public key I pin?
